dct_title_s: Hypsography - Elevation Points (Digital Map Database of China)
dct_description_sm: Abstract: Point layer which depicts elevation points in meters above sea level and degenerate contours throughout China. Polygons less than 1.5 square millimeters in circumference on the source map are represented as points.

Purpose: This data is intended for researchers, students, and policy makers for reference and mapping purposes, and to provide users with geographic data for cartographic and other types of geographic analysis. Data may be useful for earth science analysis, topographic reference or display and analysis of terrain elevations, or may be used with geographic information systems (GIS) software to provide a basemap to support graphical overlays and analysis with other spatial data
